extracted.intended_audience: technology transfer professionals (university TTO staff, licensing professionals, attorneys, industry partners)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for professionals managing academic technology transfer — covering invention assessment, IP management, marketing, licensing, start-ups, operations, and leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention Disclosure and Assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the seven fundamental areas of successful technology transfer: Invention Disclosure and Assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied responsibilities include receiving and evaluating invention disclosures to determine inventorship, patentability, commercial potential, and next steps for protection or marketing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intellectual Property Management
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the seven fundamental areas of successful technology transfer: Intellectual Property Management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encompasses protecting intellectual property through patents and copyrights and managing IP portfolios, prosecution strategies, and related decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the seven fundamental areas of successful technology transfer: Marketing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers marketing ideas and technologies to potential licensees, partners, and investors, including use of portals and promotional tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Licensing
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the seven fundamental areas of successful technology transfer: Licensing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes negotiating and executing licenses, understanding transaction terms and conditions, and using benchmarking resources to structure deals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Start-ups
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the seven fundamental areas of successful technology transfer: Start-ups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Involves creating and nurturing start-ups, supporting entrepreneurs, advising on business development and commercialization strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the seven fundamental areas of successful technology transfer: Operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers internal office organization, processes, staffing, and administrative best practices required for effective tech transfer offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the seven fundamental areas of successful technology transfer: Leadership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses leadership skills and strategic direction needed to guide tech transfer activities and institutional partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the member activities: Evaluate inventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members are expected to assess invention disclosures for novelty, utility, market fit, and patentability as part of their role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect intellectual property through patents and copyrights
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the member activities: Protect intellectual property through patents and copyrights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied standards include filing and prosecuting patents/copyrights, managing filings, and aligning protection strategies with commercialization goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the member activities: Market ideas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entails outreach, promotion, and connecting technologies with industry partners or investors for commercialization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiate and license inventions to interested companies
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the member activities: Negotiate and license inventions to interested companies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied criteria include skillful negotiation, structuring deals, and executing licensing agreements that reflect institutional objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create and nurture start-ups
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the member activities: Create and nurture start-ups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes supporting formation, advising founders, helping with business development and university spin-out processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead corporate engagements
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the member activities: Lead corporate engagements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers building and managing collaborations, sponsored research, and partnerships with industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support economic development
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the member activities: Support economic development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tech transfer activities should contribute to regional and institutional economic impact through commercialization and job creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Cooperation
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Offer: International Cooperation — programs developed for international audiences—customizable for partners and deliverable on-site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes provision of experienced instructors from research institutions and universities with extensive international experience and educational credits toward certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webinars
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Offer: Webinars — More than 90 recorded webinars to suit everyone from industry newcomers to tech transfer veterans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Webinars serve as continuing education across experience levels; selection should match user skill level and topical needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Development Courses
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Offer: Professional Development Courses including Essentials of Academic Technology Transfer; Technology Operations and Organization Licensing Skills (TOOLS); Start-up Business Development; Negotiation; Marketing; Technology Valuation; Software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Courses target core competencies in technology transfer; institutions and individuals should select courses aligned with role-specific skill gaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global Technology Portal
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Offer: Global Technology Portal — Market your technologies or find available tech.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A platform to showcase available technologies to potential licensees or to discover partnerable technologies; used as part of outreach/marketing strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: TransACT Database
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Offer: TransACT Database — Compare transaction terms and conditions with other institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides benchmarking data on licensing transactions to inform deal terms and institutional policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surveys — Annual Licensing Activity Survey
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Offer: Annual Licensing Activity Survey — measure your impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Survey data helps institutions benchmark licensing volume, revenue, and other impact metrics against peers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surveys — Salary Survey
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Offer: Salary Survey — insights on salaries, incentives, TTO staffing structures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for benchmarking compensation and organizational structures within tech transfer offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology Transfer Practice Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Offer: Technology Transfer Practice Manual — Four online volumes of tech transfer best practices and templates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains practical templates and documented best practices for managing tech transfer processes, usable as operation standards and procedural guides.
